navaid.name: Coney Island Light
navaid.description: Frank Schubert, the last civilian keeper at Coney Island Lighthouse, manned the light from 1960 until his death in 2003, even though the light was automated in 1989. He saved 15 lives and was honored at the White House by President George H. W. Bush.
